value.name: fabric-nfw-egress-blocked-domains
value.queryString: fields @timestamp, event.src_ip, event.dest_ip, event.dest_port, event.http.hostname, event.alert.signature | filter event.alert.action = 'drop' or event.alert.action = 'blocked' | stats count(*) as dropCount by event.http.hostname, event.src_ip | sort dropCount desc | limit 20

value.name: fabric-waf-top-blocked-ips
value.queryString: fields @timestamp, httpRequest.clientIp, httpRequest.country, terminatingRuleId, httpRequest.uri | filter action = 'BLOCK' | stats count(*) as blockCount by httpRequest.clientIp, httpRequest.country, terminatingRuleId | sort blockCount desc | limit 20

value.name: fabric-suricata-ids-alerts
value.queryString: fields @timestamp, src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, alert.signature, alert.category, alert.severity | filter event_type = 'alert' | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50

value.name: fabric-vpc-flow-top-rejects
value.queryString: fields @timestamp, srcAddr, dstAddr, srcPort, dstPort, protocol, action | filter action = 'REJECT' | stats count(*) as rejectedCount by srcAddr, dstAddr, dstPort | sort rejectedCount desc | limit 20
